policy: RESIDENTIAL DWELLING INSURANCE / Policy wording "WD-2026" - Portable Equipment, Repair and Replacement Edition
description: Accidental damage claim on the portable electronics cover. During the swerve on the Berlin to Munich drive, the laptop and a tablet that were in the same bag were both thrown against the car door. The laptop screen and board took a heavy hit, and the tablet screen cracked. The shop's written report says the laptop is not economical to repair, so it has been replaced. The owner chose a higher-spec model than the one that was damaged, and picked up a new carry bag and an extended warranty at the same time. A diagnostic was run on both devices. Separately, a data recovery house pulled the files off the old laptop drive and charged an administration fee. For the file: this policy carries a battery health waiver, which matters because the old laptop's battery was below 80 percent.

lines.1: Laptop replacement - equivalent to the damaged model (repair uneconomic per supplier report) | 1 pcs
lines.2: Higher-spec upgrade difference (better model than the one damaged) | 1 flat rate
lines.3: Tablet screen repair (struck in the same bag) 1 pcs
lines.4: Diagnostic inspection of both devices 1 pcs
lines.5: New laptop carry bag (not damaged in the incident) 1 pcs
lines.6: Extended warranty on the replacement laptop 1 flat rate
lines.7: Data recovery from the damaged laptop drive 1 flat rate
